notes.text:
A REGION IS A SCOPE.

Run 'spot close' and read the Out row.

'close' goes approach → strike, both inside Combat, and emits: brake · lunge · swing. Combat's own raiseWeapon and holster do NOT fire — the arrow never left the region, so the region was never entered or exited.

Now run 'spot close hurt'. The last arrow adds: recoil · holster · yell · scanArea. One arrow, unwinding two levels correctly.

The rule is the least common ancestor of the two endpoints:

  exits, innermost-first, up to the LCA
  then the arrow's own action
  then entries, outermost-first, down to the target

Nothing above the LCA is touched, because nothing above it was left. 'close' has Combat as its LCA; 'hurt' has the root.

Actions cost nothing in power. They are a side effect, Σ is unchanged, and the set of accepted words is identical with every action deleted — strip them and the verdicts below do not move.

Which is why this machine is still an HSM and not a transducer: it prints, but nothing ever reads what it printed.

meta.title: Actions: a region is a scope
meta.blurb: Entry and exit actions turn containment into scope. An arrow inside Combat runs no Combat action; an arrow out of it unwinds every level it actually leaves. The rule is the least common ancestor of the two endpoints — and none of it changes the language.
